name: @cognitive-fab/polyviz
description: Deterministic, artifact-derived diagram renderer for the Polygraph method: the state machine, the invariants, the counterexample and the polyvers compat verdict as a fixed catalog of SVGs (optional PNG). Same inputs, byte-identical output; no model call at render time.
//private: the Claude plugin needs no registry (marketplace source ./polyviz); remove this to publish
//bin: no bin entry on purpose: the plugin runs node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/polyviz.mjs by path, the root keeps its `polyviz` npm script, and a bin link would have npm rewrite the file's line endings on Windows

scripts.test: node --no-warnings --test test/determinism.test.mjs test/counterexample.test.mjs test/state-machine.test.mjs test/compat.test.mjs test/adapter.test.mjs test/adapter-machine.test.mjs test/adapter-ce.test.mjs test/example.test.mjs test/golden.test.mjs test/schema.test.mjs test/overflow.test.mjs test/theme.test.mjs test/png.test.mjs test/report.test.mjs test/no-hex.test.mjs test/brand.test.mjs
